text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone~!
Love me â¡ Love you â¡ It's Loves Only
You and!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's Curren Chan here♡ And so~...?
We've launched the official Tracen Academy
sub-channel! *clap clap*♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
This channel was started to give you all a
chill peek into the lives of academy
students like Curren and the gang,
showing a slightly different side than
what you see in races or the media~☆

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want lots of people to enjoy this in a
different way than racing♪
Now then, let's get hyped... Wait, no
one's watching--!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
This is a biiig deal☆ First, we gotta get
more subscribers...
So, what's our very first sub-channel
project going to be~? Drumroll, please!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To commemorate the launch of our official
sub-channel!
We're kicking off the "Can't Stop Till We
Hit the Goal☆Sub-Chan Video Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, the plan is for Curren and the
other academy students to post whatever
videos we like,
and hype up the channel together with all
our fans!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If you all enjoyed it, be sure to like,
subscribe, and share♡
Now then, as for our subscriber goal—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, yeeees!! Hello, it's the genius
Pandora-chanâª
If we're gonna do this, I kinda wanna get
all of Japan involvedâ¡ And so!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Let's shoot for 100 million~~~☆

(Target: 1 0 0  M i l l i o n  V i e w e r
s)
(Consulting...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup! After talking it over...~
Our subscriber target is officially set to
"100 million"~~âª

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely, po~sitively need everyone's
help...! Make sure to subscribe
and spread the word far and wide~~~~!!
...I'm super serious!!

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"'Please look forward to all the upcoming
videos♪
I hope I can meet all 100 million of you♡
Bye-byee!'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it's really been decided...
âTarget subscriber count: 100
million...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, Loves-chan, your face has gone
totally blue☆
No worries, it's a breeze! We've got the
strongest lineup ever, right~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't quite say it's easy-peasy, but
Curren thinks we'll be just fine! If all
our fans help spread the word, that's
worth a hundred people♪ And besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"These numbers are bound to get people
talking... look, we're already getting
tons of reactions!
Looks like we're well on our way to
achieving the sub-channel's goal, don't
you think?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Our goal, you mean...?
Isn't it to post cute, chill videos
totally different from the official ones?
Is there something else?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There is~. All the students handle media
activities differently, right?
Some are super active like Curren and the
others, while some don't do any at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If the only reason is just "not having the
courage"...
I was wondering if I could give them a
little push, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If it's a sub-channel, you can show up
casually with whatever content you like,
right?
The fans will love it, and it'll hype up
the academy! A total win-win♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ So that's how the two of you teamed
up.
Dang, you really put a lot of thought into
this~ Good job!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's way cuter when everyone can enjoy it
together rather than just by myself, after
all♪
Next, I'll put out a call for everyone to
post videos, brainstorm some projects—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, ooh, me! There's one thing I wanna
do~!
âI wanna do that thing where we sing and
dance!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You know, that style you see all over
UmaTok!
Dancing's the classic go-to for videos,
right?
Um...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Since we're doing it, we could even style
it like a music video~.
Oh gosh, that would be seriously so cute~♡
U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That could totally work! Since we're doing
it, we should prepare costumes too...
What do you think, Curren-san? How about
we split up the roles—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa!? When did you get here!?
Sooorry, I didn't notice!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm used to it, so... More
importantly... M-May I... participate in
the video project as well...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sure thing! But that's rare, isn't it?
Still-chan,
you don't really like standing out... do
you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"......Because of that, it seems some fans
are feeling lonely...
...I want to find the 'courage'... to
reach out too..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, love it, love it! Let's show off
our cute side♪
Let's all post tons of videos and totally
hype this up♡ Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you see that thing about the
academy starting a sub-channel? Sounds
like fun!
They said they'll help with editing,
too... Should we do something with it?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......Pointless.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Mm, this wind... ...Yeah, it's decided.
Time to head back—
Back to those guys. —Let's go have some
fun!
